mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS orderId, client_id AS clientId, trainer_id AS trainerId, lesson_count AS lessonCount, price, status FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( order_id, client_id, trainer_id, lesson_count, price, status ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{clientId}, #{trainerId}, #{lessonCount}, #{price}, 'PENDING' )
